details: The name of the food shall be the name prescribed in the relevant regulations or standard. If no name is prescribed, the common or generic name shall be used.
A complete list of ingredients in descending order of their composition by weight or volume at the time of manufacture.
exemption: Single ingredient foods, fresh fruits and vegetables

applies_to: All packaged foods with surface area > 100 cm²
details: Must declare: Energy, Protein, Carbohydrate (of which sugars), Fat (of which saturated fat and trans fat), and Sodium per 100 g/100 ml and per serve.
exemption: Small packages (<100 cm²), spices, salt, tea, coffee

details: Cereals containing gluten, Crustaceans, Eggs, Fish, Peanuts, Soybeans, Milk, Tree nuts, Sulphite (≥10 mg/kg) must be declared.

requirement: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer
details: Complete name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or bottler including street name, city, state, and country.
Net quantity in terms of weight, volume, or number in metric units (g, kg, ml, l).

requirement: Date of Manufacture and Best Before / Use By Date
details: Both manufacturing/packing date and Best Before or Use By date must be declared. Format: DD/MM/YYYY or similar clear format.
License or registration number issued by FSSAI must be displayed along with the FSSAI logo.
For imported packaged food, country of origin must be declared prominently.
Green filled circle in a square for vegetarian; brown filled circle in a square for non-vegetarian. Minimum symbol size: 3 mm diameter.

applies_to: Foods requiring preparation or special storage
details: Instructions for proper use, preparation, or reconstitution if the product requires it.
All food additives must be declared by functional class followed by specific name or INS number, e.g. Preservative (INS 211).

requirement: Minimum Font Size on Principal Display Panel
details: Font size depends on principal display panel area. <40 cm²: 1.0 mm; 40–170 cm²: 1.5 mm; 170–650 cm²: 2.0 mm; >650 cm²: 3.0 mm minimum letter height.
All mandatory information must be in sharp contrast to the background, clearly legible, and indelible.
